facts.text: The Bridgewater Commitment covers the full cost of tuition and mandatory fees for in-state students from families earning $125,000 or less.

sources.title: The Bridgewater Commitment | Free Tuition for Massachusetts Families Earning $125,000 or Less | Bridgewater State University
